newsitem.title: JAPAN: THK shares ask-only due to investment row.
newsitem.headline: THK shares ask-only due to investment row.

text.p: Shares of THK Co Ltd remained ask-only on Friday afternoon, hurt by news on Thursday that THK, which makes linear motion systems, and Paribas Asset Management Japan Ltd are in a dispute over a three billion yen fund it purchased last year.
As of 0440 GMT, the shares were quoted ask-only at 1,060 yen on the over-the-counter (OTC) market, below Thursday's 1,200 yen.

THK said in a statement on Thursday that the three billion yen fund, which it bought in November, was to be invested in Italian government bonds, but that Paribas switched the investment target without THK's permission and bought 856,000 shares in TDF Corp.
THK said that the fund had suffered a loss and it would demand that Paribas compensate it for the loss.
An official of Paribas Asset Management Japan, a unit of Paribas Asset Management SA, said separately on Thursday the company was investigating the case and declined to comment further.
